name: plan-highest-7
description: Tiered council, Muad's design (2026-09-26): the highest models for the highest tasks, the cheapest models for the mass work; since 7 Oct 2026 every seat also votes. EVERY SEAT VOTES: the owner's deliberate choice of 7 Oct 2026 ("The judging/vote is blind, and I want to put all models that have another role, to judge and vote ... it is deliberate"; "everyone who is part of the chain gets to be part of the judge and vote stage too, so yes, writer judges too. Everyone!"). It reverses the September rule that no seat both argues and votes, for this chain only: the chain-level "judging": "all-roles" switches off chain-lint's mass-seat-votes and deep-dive-votes (grep -r '"judging"' chains/ lists every chain that sets it; a chain without it is still checked), and "selfReview": "allowed" lets the plan's WRITER (a Claude Code session running Sonnet 5, which also writes the skeleton, the build, revise-N, the dispute stage and the handoff) sit on the panel too, so the writer judges its own draft. The judges are blind to each other and sign off unanimously (seats.critics, 13 labs). SEATS: criteria = Claude Opus 5.5 on the owner's Claude subscription (external, subscription:opus-5.5, lab opus5.5-sub; Muad 7 Oct: the same seat as plan-daily-7, in place of Llama 4 Maverick); MASS SEATS (seats.proposers: GPT-5.6 Luna, Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, Qwen 3.7 Plus, MiniMax M3, Mistral Medium 3.5) write the blind proposals and all the proposal debate posts and replies, and post on the architectures (alternatives.debaters "all"); ANCHOR SEATS (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5 through OpenRouter - Muad's pick 2026-09-26 and still his deliberate exception: an Anthropic model reviews a draft a Claude Code session writes - DeepSeek V4 Pro and GLM-5.3) write the whole alternative architectures (seats.alternatives) and answer the posts on them; DEEP-DIVE seat DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (one job: checking the first draft against every part of the task, 40,000 characters per call, up to 24 calls under its own $4 cap; the reviser answers its findings before the panel's first review). JUDGES (seats.critics): the four anchors, the seven mass labs, the deep-dive seat's lab (already a mass lab), the Opus 5.5 subscription seat (the criteria seat) and the plan's writer. The roster is otherwise the one of 2026-09-26. ROUTING, because a NEEDS file names only its label: every label containing opus5.5-sub goes to the Opus 5.5 session (alternative-, alt-debate-, alt-reply-, panel-N-, including the suffixed forms panel-N-opus5.5-sub-retry, -reask1, -reask2 and alternative-opus5.5-sub-retry), and so do the three criteria-stage labels, which carry no lab name (criteria, criteria-retry, criteria-feasibility-retry); every other external stage, including panel-N-sonnet5-writer, goes to the Sonnet 5 session. Nothing checks who wrote an answer. The MAJORITY GUARD is ON (authors see each argument once with no lab letter or count, the reply prompts carry an evidence bar, and a withdrawal that does not quote the argument it concedes to is kept for the builder); decision records and the dispute stage as in plan-premium-7. Dry run (0.8.2, prices of 2026-10-07): $18.49 expected, $50.43 at most - pass --max-usd above the default $7 cap. No Kimi, no xAI. Untested with real models: price it with `npm run dry` and get an explicit go before any paid run.
summary: Four anchors write architectures; every seat in the chain votes, blind, the plan's writer too.
